yaml:
name: Godot Addon CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Restore godot/ source directory
      run: git checkout -- godot/

    - name: Remove amy_midi.c and add MIDI stubs
      run: |
        rm godot/addons/amy/src/amy_midi.c
        echo "void midi_init() {}" >> godot/addons/amy/src/amy_platform_stubs.c
        echo "void midi_play_note(int note, int velocity) {}" >> godot/addons/amy/src/amy_platform_stubs.c
        echo "void midi_stop_note(int note) {}" >> godot/addons/amy/src/amy_platform_stubs.c

    - name: Build Godot addon
      if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
      run: |
        mkdir build
        cd build
        cmake .. -G "Visual Studio 16 2019" -A x64
        cmake --build . --config Release

    - name: Build Godot addon
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'
      run: |
        mkdir build
        cd build
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
        make

    - name: Archive artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: godot-addon-${{ matrix.os }}
        path: build/*.dll
        if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
      - name: Archive artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: godot-addon-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: build/*.so
          if: matrix.os == 'linux'
      - name: Archive artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: godot-addon-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: build/*.dylib
          if: matrix.os == 'macos'
